summary: SPAN destination oversubscription causing 27.22% loss plus 2.98% inter-device link loss; NDR missing ~29% of packets, severely degrading detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: LEAF-07 Gi1/0/48 SPAN destination port is oversubscribed: 10,305,000 packets (~1.37 Gbps) mirrored from LEAF-07 Gi1/0/1 policed through 1 Gbps SPAN destination, switch discarded 2,805,000 packets on output at 100% average load (bursts higher) = 27.22% loss. Additional 2.98% loss between LEAF-07 Gi1/0/48 (sent 7,500,000) and NPB-01 port 1 (saw 7,276,200) indicates cable/optic or unmonitored device on that patch.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR (requires both directions and full payload) loses ~29% of traffic end-to-end; flows are incomplete, signatures and behavioral analytics will miss intrusions, lateral movement and C2, creating blind spots and false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: Passive TAP forwards at line rate with no SPAN CPU/buffer or 1G destination limit, eliminating the 27% oversubscription drops and burst loss while preserving both directions/full payload for NDR. Also remediate the lossy patch LEAF-07 Gi1/0/48 to NPB-01 port 1 (check/replace optic/cable) as part of TAP aggregation.
